hook in the first 2 seconds.on: frame-0.png, the strips and the settled frames of the first 3 s
hook in the first 2 seconds.10: the first second stops the scroll with a striking image, word or move, and by 2 s the viewer knows what kind of film this is
hook in the first 2 seconds.7: the opening is clear by 2 to 3 s, or the first second is calm but sets up a payoff that lands by 2 s
hook in the first 2 seconds.4: nothing grabs attention until after 3 s, or the opening is a static logo or wordmark
hook in the first 2 seconds.1: nothing in the first 3 s gives a reason to keep watching

readability on a phone.10: every word the viewer must read reads at phone size: at least {{min_text_px}} px tall in this frame (11 pt on a phone), clear against what is behind it, and on screen long enough for its purpose (a one-word beat may hold a single beat)
readability on a phone.7: one element is smaller than that, low in contrast, or not still long enough to read
readability on a phone.4: several elements are hard to read, or one main line is
readability on a phone.1: the main message cannot be read
readability on a phone.note: HUD labels, counters, timecodes and texture type are design elements, not reading text: judge them only if they block or confuse the main message.

composition.10: each settled frame has one clear focal point, uses the frame, and nothing collides, clips or overlaps by accident
composition.7: one frame is crowded, lopsided or mostly empty (for example, everything in the top half)
composition.4: several frames are crowded or empty, or elements collide or clip
composition.1: the layout is broken: overlapping or cut-off text

variety.on: the strips and the settled frames, inside this video only
variety.10: each beat changes something different: new content, a new layout or a new kind of move, and nothing repeats back to back
variety.7: one move or layout repeats back to back
variety.4: most beats reuse the same move or layout
variety.note: Earlier videos never count here: a repeat of one goes in `repeat`.

brand accuracy.on: the settled frames, preset.json and composition.css
brand accuracy.10: only the preset's fonts and colours appear, and every brand rule holds
brand accuracy.7: one slip a careful viewer would notice (name the rule and the sample)
brand accuracy.4: a brand rule any viewer would notice is broken
brand accuracy.note: Check fonts, sizes and shadows in composition.css before calling them wrong from the pixels.

motion quality.10: no visible defect in any move: no flash frame, flicker, stutter, jump or jolt, and every move ends cleanly
motion quality.7: one move has a visible defect
motion quality.4: several moves have visible defects, or a move hides content the viewer needs
motion quality.1: the motion is broken: flashes, flicker or jumping elements throughout

*.10: no problem a viewer would notice
*.7: one problem a viewer would notice (name it and the sample)
